raw_model_deviations.issue: “produced exactly this kind of surprise” turns the Japanese source’s description of a test that suggested this kind of scenario into a claim that the test actually produced the surprise. raw_model_deviations.explanation: The source describes a test that evoked the scenario; the article says the test produced it.
